title: Olympus OM-1 Basic CLA
description: A basic clean, lube and adjust (CLA) of the Olympus OM-1 35mm SLR camera, covering shutter speed accuracy, mirror damper replacement, and light seal replacement.

steps.title: Tools and materials
steps.text: Before starting, gather: JIS screwdrivers (#000, #00, #0), spanner wrench, rubber grip pads, isopropyl alcohol (90%+), lighter fluid (naphtha), Molykote EM-30L grease, Fluorosilicone oil, foam tape for light seals, and cotton swabs.

steps.title: Remove the bottom plate
steps.text: Remove the three screws on the bottom plate using a JIS #0 screwdriver. Note that screws may be different lengths — keep track of their positions. Carefully lift off the bottom plate, noting how the film advance and rewind mechanisms sit.

steps.title: Check shutter speeds
steps.text: With the bottom plate removed, use a shutter speed tester (or a smartphone app with the microphone near the shutter) to check the accuracy of each shutter speed from B through 1/1000s. Note any speeds that are running slow — these will be adjusted after cleaning and lubrication.
